You are choosing one picture for a children's story scene.
Scene: Kavin walks happily towards a huge mango tree heavy with golden mangoes and lifts his trunk to pick the biggest one
Characters and how they must look: Kavin the baby elephant: a small round baby elephant with soft blue-grey skin, big floppy ears with pink insides, a short curly trunk, bright curious eyes and a red-and-yellow striped scarf.
Art style: soft watercolor picture-book illustration for young children, warm pastel colours, rounded friendly shapes, gentle golden light, clean uncluttered composition

There are 2 pictures, numbered 1 to 2 in the order given. Pick the picture that best matches the scene, keeps every character on model, looks warm and safe for small children and has no text in it.
Answer with only the number of the best picture.
